content.thinking: Found one unbalanced journal, one line with a bad account, one non-positive invoice, and one journal with a REF_JRNL_NO — I'll dig into each of these along with the journal line layout and period date alignment.

input.sql: SELECT l.*, '['||l."ACCT_CD"||']' acct FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT") UNION SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" l2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l2."ACCT_CD") UNION SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT "REF_JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT * FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR "JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "REF_JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH")
SELECT i.*, h."MEMO", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE i."INV_AMT"<=0 OR i."INV_ID" IN (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APINVH" ORDER BY "INV_ID" LIMIT 3)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT") dt_outside_period, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT") post_after_close, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT") pay_before_inv, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x) multi_pay, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT") pay_amt_diff, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")) paid_nopay, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")) open_withpay, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APVEND" WHERE length("VEND_CD")<>8) v_len, (SELECT count(DISTINCT "VEND_CD") FROM "APINVH") inv_vendors
